description.value:
A piercing, deafening ring erupts from a point you choose within range. Every creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered there must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 3d8 sonic damage, halved on a success; a creature made of stone, crystal, metal, or similar inorganic material has disadvantage on this save. An unattended, unenhanced object in the area takes the damage as well.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level beyond 2nd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
